name: io.github.TryLadoo/ladoo-mcp
title: Ladoo
description: Calls, people, agents, knowledge and bookings from your Ladoo AI receptionist workspace.

environmentVariables.name: LADOO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Ladoo API key from Settings → Developers. A read-only key is enough for the default tools.

environmentVariables.name: LADOO_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to also register tools that change data.

environmentVariables.name: LADOO_TIME_ZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA time zone for dates like 2026-11-20. Defaults to the system time zone.
